authoring_clarifications_20261008.status: generated_unexecuted; no protocol or scientific gate promoted
authoring_clarifications_20261008.raw_control_reason: The actual direct-mode apply_displacement clamps raw decoder coordinates to [-1,1]. Add raw_uncorrected to isolate removal of that clamp from self-map subtraction; retain all four originally required roles.
authoring_clarifications_20261008.supported_native_scope: Frozen ActionBench producer: source frame 0 plus all 15 target frames in one complete captured decoder window. Reject changed/missing/overlapping windows and unsupported time schedules rather than invent cross-window coupling.
authoring_clarifications_20261008.method: F_t(X) denotes decoder(context,cast_to_native_query_dtype(X),a,t). Both calls share the same recorded q and normals. For non-anchor targets H_t=X+F_t(X)-F_a(X); source anchor is original native float32 X. Query-cast discrepancy is retained in the certificate; no clipping.
authoring_clarifications_20261008.control: For non-anchor targets M_t=F_t-mean_v(F_a-X). raw_uncorrected preserves F_t; both retain exact source anchor X.
authoring_clarifications_20261008.coordinate_policy: Explicit preserve-and-report or reject policy frozen before outputs are inspected. Neither clips. A rejected preparation remains in the logical denominator; no successful-arm substitution.
authoring_clarifications_20261008.metric_interpretation: Official cd_motion matches sampled surfaces on the first frame and averages unsquared coordinate distances over all frames. It is not a velocity loss. Time-constant bias subtraction leaves target-target vertex differences unchanged and does not guarantee any native metric improvement.
authoring_clarifications_20261008.novelty: Diagnostic/baseline role retained. Shape Flow Guidance already uses anchored differences; no novelty claim from this source completion.
